fable.w: This section only lists appropriation amounts and releases of funds for Bureau of Mines-type accounts under Public Law 90-218. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any decision.

qwen_block.w: This section lists budget appropriations and releases of funds for various categories such as mineral resources, health and safety, and administrative expenses. It does not contain any language requiring consultation, coordination, or participation with entities outside the federal government. It is purely a financial authorization.
qwen_block.s: “Conservation and development, of mineral resources”, $645,000; (and release of $100,000 pursuant to Public Law 90–218). “Health and safety”, $61,009; (and release of $200,000 pursuant to Public Law 90–218). “Solid waste disposal”: (Release of $33,000 pursuant to Public Law 90–218). “General administrative expenses”, $41,000.

opus.w: This section only appropriates or releases funds for budget categories such as mineral resources, health and safety, solid waste disposal and administrative expenses. It does not involve any party outside the federal government in a federal decision. Category names like "Health and safety" may sound regulatory, but no comment period, rulemaking, consultation, advisory body or right to sue is created.
opus.b: This section is purely an appropriations provision. It lists dollar amounts and releases of funds under Public Law 90–218 for budget categories like "Health and safety." Those category names might suggest a regulatory program, but the text sets up no process, consultation, hearing, or rulemaking.

qwen_chat.w: This section lists specific dollar amounts appropriated for various categories such as mineral resources, health and safety, and solid waste disposal. It contains no language requiring or recommending consultation, public comment, hearings, or coordination with outside parties. It is purely a financial authorization.
qwen_chat.s: “Conservation and development, of mineral resources”, $645,000; (and release of $100,000 pursuant to Public Law 90–218). “Health and safety”, $61,009; (and release of $200,000 pursuant to Public Law 90–218). “Solid waste disposal”: (Release of $33,000 pursuant to Public Law 90–218). “General administrative expenses”, $41,000.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "Solid waste disposal" or "Health and safety" implies public involvement or consultation regarding these topics. However, the text is purely a list of budget appropriations and releases of funds. It does not describe any process, hearing, committee, or consultation mechanism. It is simply an authorization of money.
